name: Band Camp Arcade
description: Six small, silly, entirely local browser toys for marching band kids: a tuning-drone endurance timer, a pit-crew drag game, a uniform-misery tracker, a shuffled sectional bingo card, a satirical caption-score roast generator, and a drum-major-commands memory game. No accounts, no build step, no network calls.
author: USER

data_streams.purpose: Personal best time surviving the tuning drone
data_streams.retention: until the user clears the browser origin's storage — there is no server copy to clear
data_streams.description: localStorage key tuning-purgatory-best. A single number.

data_streams.purpose: Personal best score across Pit Crew Simulator runs
data_streams.retention: until the user clears the browser origin's storage
data_streams.description: localStorage key pit-crew-best-score. A single number.

data_streams.purpose: Per-game suffering log the user chooses to keep — date, event name, felt-like temperature, a 1-10 score, and a free-text complaint
data_streams.retention: until the user deletes an entry or clears the browser origin's storage
data_streams.description: localStorage key uniform-sweat-entries, a JSON array. The complaint field is free text the user writes about their own experience; nothing here is fetched, inferred, or shared.

data_streams.purpose: The current bingo card and marks, plus any custom squares the user added to the shuffle pool
data_streams.retention: until the user clears marks/generates a new card, or clears the browser origin's storage
data_streams.description: localStorage keys sectional-bingo-card and sectional-bingo-custom-pool. Custom squares are free text the user writes (typically section inside jokes); nothing here is fetched, inferred, or shared.

data_streams.purpose: Best streak (rounds cleared in one run) in Drum Major Says
data_streams.retention: until the user clears the browser origin's storage — there is no server copy to clear
data_streams.description: localStorage key drum-major-best-streak. A single number.

notes.status: Prototype. Five games re-landed from the quick-stupids playground; the sixth (Drum Major Says) was written natively here. It runs and it is gated (21 assertions across six suites, plus a mutation pass proving each of six gates can actually fail); it has not been used by anyone but its author.
notes.ge_score_roast_has_no_storage: Five of the six games persist a small amount of state; GE Score Roast does not — it is a stateless generator, entered and left with nothing written to storage. Listed here so the data_streams above are read as a full account of what this app touches, not an abbreviated one.
notes.store_scope: Deliberately empty, same reasoning as jarvis: this app touches neither SOIL nor the vault. Its only persistence is browser localStorage, on the user's own machine.
notes.ci_blind_spots: This is the second app in the store with no Python in it (after jarvis), so the four drift-guard suites and tools/vault_leak_lint.py all skip it (they glob *.py) — vault_leak_lint reports UNKNOWN for this app, not PASS, per docs/ci.md. Its own workflow (.github/workflows/band-camp-arcade.yml) is the actual gate: Node, real Chromium, one suite per game, and a mutation pass.
notes.re_landing: Rebuilt against this store's manifest/catalog/CI conventions rather than copied — see README.md for what specifically changed from the quick-stupids originals (a favicon fix to stop a spurious console 404, a nav link tying the five pages into one bundle, and a pit-crew retry-on-miss behavior change that predates this re-land).
